import sys
import math

def poly_multiply(a, b, mod):
    len_a = len(a)
    len_b = len(b)
    result_size = len_a + len_b - 1
    fft_len = 1
    while fft_len < result_size:
        fft_len <<= 1

    re_a = [0.0] * fft_len
    im_a = [0.0] * fft_len
    re_b = [0.0] * fft_len
    im_b = [0.0] * fft_len

    for i in range(len_a):
        val = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        re_a[i] = val & 0x7fff
        im_a[i] = val >> 15

    for i in range(len_b):
        val = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        re_b[i] = val & 0x7fff
        im_b[i] = val >> 15

    perform_fft(re_a, im_a, False)
    perform_fft(re_b, im_b, False)

    res_re = [0.0] * fft_len
    res_im = [0.0] * fft_len
    extra_re = [0.0] * fft_len
    extra_im = [0.0] * fft_len

    scale_factor = 0.25 / fft_len

    for i in range(fft_len):
        j = (fft_len - i) & (fft_len - 1)

        a1r = (re_a[i] + re_a[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (im_a[i] - im_a[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (im_a[i] + im_a[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (re_a[j] - re_a[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (re_b[i] + re_b[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (im_b[i] - im_b[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (im_b[i] + im_b[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (re_b[j] - re_b[i]) * 0.5

        res_re[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        res_im[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        extra_re[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        extra_im[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

    perform_fft(res_re, res_im, True)
    perform_fft(extra_re, extra_im, True)

    result = [0] * result_size
    for i in range(result_size):
        part1 = round(res_re[i])
        part2 = round(extra_re[i])
        part3 = round(res_im[i])
        result[i] = int((part1 + ((part2 % mod) << 15) + ((part3 % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return result

def perform_fft(re, im, inverse):
    n = len(re)
    if n == 0:
        return
    leading_zeros = bin(n).count('0', 2) - bin(n).rfind('1')
    bit_reverse_shift = 32 - leading_zeros if leading_zeros > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(32)[::-1], 2) >> bit_reverse_shift
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

    segment = 2
    while segment <= n:
        half = segment >> 1
        cosines = [0.0] * half
        sines = [0.0] * half
        angle_step = 2 * math.pi / segment * (-1 if inverse else 1)
        for i in range(half):
            cosines[i] = math.cos(i * angle_step)
            sines[i] = math.sin(i * angle_step)

        start = 0
        while start < n:
            for offset in range(half):
                cr = cosines[offset]
                ci = sines[offset]
                ur = re[start + offset]
                ui = im[start + offset]
                vr = re[start + offset + half] * cr - im[start + offset + half] * ci
                vi = re[start + offset + half] * ci + im[start + offset + half] * cr

                re[start + offset] = ur + vr
                im[start + offset] = ui + vi
                re[start + offset + half] = ur - vr
                im[start + offset + half] = ui - vi
            start += segment
        segment <<= 1

    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, input_stream):
        self.input_stream = input_stream
        self.buffer = bytearray(1024)
        self.buffer_index = 0
        self.buffer_size = 0

    def read(self):
        if self.buffer_size == -1:
            raise RuntimeError()
        if self.buffer_index >= self.buffer_size:
            self.buffer_index = 0
            try:
                self.buffer_size = self.input_stream.readinto(self.buffer)
            except:
                raise RuntimeError()
            if self.buffer_size <= 0:
                return -1
        result = self.buffer[self.buffer_index]
        self.buffer_index += 1
        return result

    def next_int(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c <= ord(' '):
            if c == -1:
                raise RuntimeError()
        sign = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sign = -1
            c = self.read()
        num = 0
        while c > ord(' '):
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise RuntimeError()
            num = num * 10 + (c - ord('0'))
            c = self.read()
        return num * sign

def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin.buffer)
    out = sys.stdout

    MOD = 998244353
    n = in_reader.next_int()
    k = in_reader.next_int()
    base = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        base[in_reader.next_int()] = 1

    ans = [1]
    exp = n // 2
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            ans = poly_multiply(ans, base, MOD)
        base = poly_multiply(base, base, MOD)
        exp >>= 1

    total_sum = 0
    for val in ans:
        total_sum = (total_sum + val * val) % MOD
    out.write(str(total_sum).encode())
    out.write(b'\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
